# compression-bench

> Benchmark CLI that compares zstd, lz4, brotli and gzip on your data for ratio, throughput and peak memory, with seeded corpora pinned by SHA-256 for reproducible reports Rust crate `trysac-compression-bench`, library `compression_bench`, MIT licensed,
> Rust >= 1.88 (edition 2024), standard library only.
